Card Q&A.q: Do I have to delete all of my Digimon for this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect even when I have 0 cards in my Digi-Egg deck and can't place a card in digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, they are. When cards such as [Leviamon] and [Leviamon (X Antibody)] differ in that one has [X Antibody] in its name and the other doesn't, you can reference the cards as if they have different names.
Card Q&A.q: If [Leviamon] and [Leviamon (X Antibody)] are in this card's digivolution cards, are they considered "cards with different names"?
Does [Gate of Deadly Sins] itself in digivolution cards also count for this card's "if this Digimon has 5 or more digivolution cards with different names"?
If multiple copies of this card are in digivolution cards, does its inherited effect overlap?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can choose not to.
Card Q&A.q: Do I have to activate this card's inherited effect when a Digimon card would be played?
Can I also activate this card's inherited effect when a Digimon would be played by an effect?
Can I use this card's inherited effect to reduce the digivolution cost by 3 even if this card has 5 or more digivolution cards with different names?

Effect: [Breeding] [Start of Your Main Phase] Place the top card of your Digi-Egg deck as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, and delete all of your Digimon. If this effect deleted, place 1 [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait card from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
[Breeding] [End of Opponent’s Turn] By deleting this Digimon with 7 or more digivolution cards with different names, you may play 1 [Ogudomon] from your trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Breeding] [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait Digimon cards would be played, you may reduce the play costs by 3. If this Digimon has 5 or more digivolution cards with different names, you may instead reduce the play costs by 4.
Notes: 2024 Championship Regionals Finalist Card Set Wave 3
